stemMd: A tax charges 10% on the first €10000 of income and 20% only on the next €10000. What tax is due on €15000 under this simplified rule?
explanationMd: The first ten thousand produces €1000 of tax. The remaining five thousand is taxed at twenty percent, producing another €1000. The total is €2000; the higher marginal rate applies only to the upper slice.

distractorRationale.b: This applies the upper rate to all income.
distractorRationale.c: This applies only the lower rate.
distractorRationale.e: This does not follow the stated brackets.
distractorRationale.d: This ignores the taxable income above the first bracket.
